frozen_change: Replace only the DSIR common-support cubic interpolation at each selected target k by an exact target-k insertion through CLASS k_output_values, then recover d_m at that exact requested k. Keep the same pinned CLASS source, baseline, precision, h, native k density and beta-plus/beta-minus response definition.

pre_registered_decision.support_interpolation_dominant: For unique failing coordinates, fine-to-direct is smaller than coarse-to-direct for at least 75 percent, median(fine-to-direct/coarse-to-direct) <= 0.75, and matched controls have max fine-to-direct < 0.001.
pre_registered_decision.fine_support_already_within_direct_toler: Additionally report whether max fine-to-direct over unique failing coordinates is < 0.001; this is a stronger but not required condition.
pre_registered_decision.finite_difference_or_upstream_direct_con: If the support_interpolation_dominant rule fails while exact target-k binding and invariants pass, do not mutate h in this run; authorize only a separately frozen h-stability audit.
pre_registered_decision.inconclusive: Any target-k binding failure, nonfinite direct value, source identity mismatch, control failure >= 0.001, or disagreement between duplicate labeled probes makes the run diagnostic-inconclusive rather than scientific evidence.

authorized_next_stage_only_if_successful: Use V0.4 classification to choose either support/interpolation repair validation or a separately prospectively frozen h-stability audit.
